email.preview_text: A first look at the spring collection before it goes live tomorrow.
email.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

You've been with us for a while — long enough that we wanted to send the spring catalog your way before everyone else.

Inside: a few new ceramics, a brass piece we've been quietly perfecting since last fall, and one restock that always sells out.

Take a look. No code needed; the prices you see are yours.

Browse the collection →

sms.body: Hi {{first_name}}, spring catalog is live for you 24h early. {{link}}

email.subject_line: It's been a while — 15% off, on us
email.preview_text: A small thank-you for coming back. No catch.
email.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We noticed you haven't been by in a few months, and we'd rather not let that go without saying hello.

Use HEARTH15 at checkout for 15% off anything in the shop through Sunday. The cast iron skillet has been the most-loved thing we make this year — if you missed it last time, this is the moment.

Come back when you're ready.

Shop with HEARTH15 →

sms.body: Hi {{first_name}}, 15% off through Sunday with HEARTH15. {{link}}

email.preview_text: A quick note on why we make what we make.
email.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome in. This is day three of a short welcome series — no pitch today, just context.

Field & Hearth started in a one-room studio in Vermont. We make slow goods for the home: things designed to be used every day for a long time, not replaced next season.

If you're curious, the journals are where most people start. They're $14, and they last.

Read the full story →
